paragraphs: Fill-in-the-blank study app for Anki decks: pre-process a .apkg export into JSON, import it in the browser, and type out each word of the answer instead of just flipping the card. Scheduling models Anki's actual default algorithm (new → learning steps → review, lapses → relearning). Progress lives in the browser's localStorage — no account, no sync, nothing leaves the browser right now (see "Sync (planned)" below for why the Firestore backend already exists but isn't wired up to anything yet).
